feature: outlier-detection child wrappers inside SharedChannel weighted_target

contracts: each composite wrapper owns independent child-policy state
success-rate and failure-percentage buckets rotate per configured interval
maximum ejection percentage is scoped to eligible endpoints in that wrapper
ejection multiplier and expiry persist per endpoint and wrapper
ejected endpoints are unavailable to the delegated child picker

implementation.indexing: runtime construction assigns one stable index to every outlier wrapper
implementation.worker_storage: each worker allocates one persistent Endpoint state per wrapper
implementation.recording: unary and streaming terminal completion records into every matching wrapper along the worker tree path
implementation.evaluation: wrapper-local hierarchy filtering drives existing grpc-core-compatible success/failure evaluator
implementation.picker_integration: pick-first, round-robin, least-request, ring-hash and WRR all exclude ejected workers
implementation.deadline: State reports the earliest wrapper evaluation deadline so idle workers wake for unejection without application traffic
implementation.isolation: sibling wrappers use separate counters, multipliers and timestamps
implementation.allocation: worker state arrays and outlier-wrapped runtime construction are transactional

ejection: round-robin sends two calls each to one healthy and one always-UNAVAILABLE endpoint
20 ms evaluation ejects only the all-failing endpoint
the next five RPCs all use the healthy sibling
200 ms expiry automatically restores the ejected endpoint state
sibling_isolation: two weighted targets each own a separate outlier wrapper
each worker has two wrapper slots
only its matching slot records successes; the sibling slot retains zero successes and failures
native_cases.allocation: outlier-wrapped nested runtime passes every induced allocation failure

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel weighted target outlier' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='SharedChannel weighted target runtime construction' --summary all
remaining_gap: resolver membership churn, delayed child retention, and ordinary Channel remain before broad weighted_target completion
